lines.en: It's the worst thing that can happen on an anniversary ever.
Oh, good. All right, you decided to tell about the Richard thing.
Okay, I, um, I ran into Richard yesterday,
and he asked me if I wanted to go for a bite,
And the only reason why I didn't tell you
is because I-- I knew you'd get mad,
and I didn't want to spoil our anniversary.
Yeah, so you-- you bumped into Richard.
